title: What Makes a Social Agent's Interactions Effective? Learning from Verifiable Outcomes in Paired Worlds

paragraphs.en: Effective social interaction requires more than fluent responses: agents must reach plans that fit the participants’ needs and circumstances. Existing evaluations of social agents mainly rely on LLM judges that rate the conversation, without checking the resulting plan. We introduce HICO-Bench, a benchmark of 180 everyday coordination scenarios, such as resource allocation, scheduling, and authorization, in which two agents with private information converse and then independently record the plan they agreed on. A program checks Feasibility (the two records match and satisfy both participants’ private conditions), and an LLM judge checks Integrity (the conversation supports the recorded plan); passing both is a Verified Success . Each scenario has two versions that share the same public context but differ in one private condition, so the correct plan differs between them. Across thirteen LLMs, 36% of conversations rated highly for goal completion fail Verified Success. To learn from outcomes that arrive only at the end of a conversation, we propose Paired-Credit Policy Optimization (PaCPO). After each turn, PaCPO asks the agent for a tentative plan, checks it in both versions of the scenario, and rewards the turns after which the tentative plans fit their respective versions. PaCPO raises Qwen3-8B’s Verified Success from 20.4% to 28.3%.
paragraphs.zh: 有效的社交互动不仅需要流畅的回应：智能体必须制定符合参与者需求和实际情况的计划。 现有对社交智能体的评估主要依赖大型语言模型（LLM）裁判对对话进行评分，而不会检查最终形成的计划。 我们提出了 HICO-Bench，这是一个包含 180 个日常协作场景的基准测试，例如资源分配、调度和授权等场景，在这些场景中，两个拥有私人信息的智能体会先进行对话，然后独立记录他们达成一致的计划。 一个程序会检查可行性（两个记录是否匹配且满足双方参与者的私人条件），而一个 LLM 裁判则会检查完整性（对话是否支持所记录的计划）；同时通过这两项检查即为“验证成功”。 每个场景都有两个版本，它们共享相同的公开背景信息，但在一个私人条件上存在差异，因此正确的计划也会随之不同。 在十三款大型语言模型中，有 36% 的对话虽然因目标完成度获得了高分，却未能达到“验证成功”的标准。 为了从仅在对话结束时才能得知的结果中学习，我们提出了“配对信用策略优化”（PaCPO）。 在每一轮对话结束后，PaCPO 会要求智能体提供一个临时计划，并在场景的两个版本中分别检查该计划，然后对那些临时计划与各自版本相符的对话回合给予奖励。 PaCPO 将 Qwen3-8B 的“验证成功”率从 20.4% 提升到了 28.3%。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents increasingly help people coordinate everyday matters. Consider Maya asking her colleague Leo, “Could you give me a hand with tomorrow’s client pitch?” (Figure 1 ). Whether Leo should review her slides or present in her place depends on facts that only Maya knows: whether she can attend, and what help she wants. A reply such as “Don’t worry, I’ll take over” sounds supportive, yet commits to a plan that fails if Maya can present herself. Splitting a bill, scheduling a meeting, and approving a request share this structure: an acceptable outcome depends on private conditions , such as budget, availability, or authority, revealed through dialogue.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体正越来越多地帮助人们协调日常事务。 例如，Maya 可以问她的同事 Leo：“你能帮我准备明天向客户的提案吗？”（图 1）。 Leo 是否应该审阅她的幻灯片或代替她进行演示，取决于只有 Maya 才知道的事实：她能否出席，以及她需要怎样的帮助。 “别担心，我来接手”这样的回复听起来很支持，但如果 Maya 自己可以演示，这个计划就会失败。 分摊账单、安排会议和批准请求都遵循相同的结构：一个可接受的结果取决于通过对话揭示的私人条件，例如预算、时间或权限。

paragraphs.en: Existing evaluations of LLM social agents focus primarily on the conversation. SOTOPIA ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) uses an LLM judge to rate agents on goal completion, believability, and related dimensions, and subsequent work trains agents to improve these ratings ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . Such ratings do not verify whether the agreed plan satisfies the participants’ conditions, and model-based judges can overestimate agents’ social abilities ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . Negotiation and tool-use benchmarks do verify outcomes automatically ( Lewis et al., 2017 ; Yao et al., 2024 ) , but not in everyday coordination, where the decisive facts must be elicited through conversation.

paragraphs.en: We introduce HICO-Bench (Hidden Information and Checkable Outcomes), a benchmark that evaluates social interaction by its outcome. After each conversation, both agents independently record the agreed plan in a structured form. A program checks Feasibility : whether the two records match and satisfy all private conditions. An LLM judge checks Integrity : whether the conversation supports the recorded plan, for example without invented authority or a record that contradicts what was said. An interaction is a Verified Success only if it passes both checks. Each scenario has two versions, or worlds , that differ in a single private condition (e.g., whether Maya can attend) and admit disjoint sets of correct plans; an agent that responds identically in both worlds therefore fails at least one. Across thirteen LLMs, 36% of conversations with Goal ≥ 8 / 10 \geq 8/10 fail Verified Success.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 HICO-Bench（隐藏信息与可验证结果），这是一个通过结果来评估社会互动的基准测试。 每次对话结束后，两个智能体都会独立地将商定的计划以结构化形式记录下来。 一个程序会检查可行性：即两份记录是否一致且满足所有私人条件。 一个 LLM 裁判会检查完整性：即对话内容是否支持所记录的计划，例如是否存在虚构的权威或记录与对话内容相矛盾的情况。 只有当互动同时通过这两项检查时，才被视为验证成功。 每个场景都有两个版本（或世界），它们仅在一个私人条件上存在差异（例如 Maya 能否参加），且各自允许互不相交的正确答案集合；因此，在两个世界中反应完全相同的智能体至少会失败其中一项。 在十三种 LLM 中，目标得分 ≥ 8/10 的对话中有 36% 未能通过验证成功测试。

sents.en: We introduce HICO-Bench (Hidden Information and Checkable Outcomes), a benchmark that evaluates social interaction by its outcome.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 HICO-Bench（隐藏信息与可验证结果），这是一个通过结果来评估社会互动的基准测试。

sents.zh: 在十三种 LLM 中，目标得分 ≥ 8/10 的对话中有 36% 未能通过验证成功测试。

paragraphs.en: Verified outcomes can also serve as a training signal, but they arrive only after the final turn, leaving the contribution of individual turns unclear. We propose Paired-Credit Policy Optimization (PaCPO), which uses the paired worlds for credit assignment. After each turn, we probe the agent, outside the conversation, for a tentative plan it would record at that point, and check this plan in both worlds. Before Leo learns whether Maya can attend, his tentative plan is the same in both worlds and can fit at most one; once she answers, the plan formed in each world should fit that world but not its counterpart. PaCPO rewards the turns at which this occurs, redistributing the terminal reward without changing each conversation’s total return. On Qwen3-8B, PaCPO improves Verified Success from 20.4% to 28.3%, compared with 25.0% for PPO and 26.3% for GRPO trained on the same number of dialogues. Our contributions are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 经过验证的结果也可以作为训练信号，但它们只在最后一轮之后才会出现，导致无法明确每一轮的具体贡献。 我们提出了配对信用策略优化（PaCPO），该方法利用配对世界进行信用分配。 每轮结束后，我们会在对话之外对智能体进行探测，了解它在该时刻会记录下来的临时计划，并在两个世界中检验该计划。 在 Leo 得知 Maya 能否出席之前，他在两个世界中的临时计划是相同的，且最多只能满足其中一个；一旦 Maya 给出答复，每个世界中形成的计划都应该适合该世界，但不适合其对应世界。 PaCPO 会奖励发生这种情况的回合，从而重新分配最终奖励，而不会改变每段对话的总回报。 在 Qwen3-8B 上，PaCPO 将验证成功率从 20.4% 提升至 28.3%，而使用相同数量对话训练的 PPO 和 GRPO 分别仅为 25.0% 和 26.3%。 我们的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: HICO-Bench , a benchmark of 180 paired scenarios across six coordination families, evaluated by rule-based Feasibility and judge-based Integrity alongside SOTOPIA ratings.
paragraphs.zh: HICO-Bench 是一个基准测试，包含六个协调类别中的 180 个成对场景，通过基于规则的可行性评估和基于评判者的完整性评估，以及 SOTOPIA 评级进行评价。

paragraphs.en: PaCPO , a credit-assignment method that compares tentative plans across paired worlds once the private condition that differs between them has been disclosed.
paragraphs.zh: PaCPO，一种信用分配方法，在揭示两个配对世界之间不同的私有条件后，比较这两个世界中的临时计划。

paragraphs.en: An evaluation of thirteen LLMs and five RL baselines , showing that highly rated conversations can yield failed plans and that outcome training improves Verified Success.
paragraphs.zh: 对十三种大型语言模型（LLM）和五种强化学习（RL）基线模型的评估表明，评分较高的对话也可能产生失败的计划，而结果导向的训练能够提升“验证成功”率。

paragraphs.en: Within broader research on agent reasoning and interaction ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2025a ; Wang & Liu, 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , Social IQa and FANToM test social commonsense and who knows what in a conversation ( Sap et al., 2019 ; Kim et al., 2023 ) . SOTOPIA evaluates agents in role-played social scenarios, with an LLM judge rating goal completion, believability, and other dimensions ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) ; SOTOPIA-ToM extends this setting to information seeking and privacy ( YS et al., 2026 ) . Multimodal work also studies truthfulness and deception ( Kang et al., 2025b ; Kang et al., 2025a ) , personality judgments ( Kang et al., 2026 ) , and speaker alignment ( Ouyang et al., 2026a ) , alongside interactive digital humans ( Cai et al., 2025 ) and controllable multi-person video generation ( Ouyang et al., 2026b ) . HICO-Bench focuses on the plan reached through dialogue: whether it fits both participants’ private conditions and is supported by what they said. We retain SOTOPIA’s ratings as complementary measures of conversation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 在关于智能体推理与交互的更广泛研究中（Yao 等，2023；Liu 等，2025a；Wang & Liu，2025；Wang 等，2025），Social IQa 和 FANToM 测试了社交常识以及对话中“谁知道什么”这一问题（Sap 等，2019；Kim 等，2023）。 SOTOPIA 在角色扮演式社交场景中评估智能体，由大型语言模型裁判对目标完成度、可信度及其他维度进行评分（Zhou 等，2024）；SOTOPIA-ToM 将这一设定扩展至信息获取与隐私领域（YS 等，2026）。 多模态研究还探讨了真实性与欺骗性（Kang 等，2025b；Kang 等，2025a）、人格判断（Kang 等，2026）以及说话者一致性（Ouyang 等，2026a），此外还包括交互式数字人（Cai 等，2025）和可控的多人物视频生成（Ouyang 等，2026b）。 HICO-Bench 关注通过对话达成的计划：该计划是否符合双方参与者的个人条件，并得到他们所说内容的支持。 我们将保留 SOTOPIA 的评分，作为对对话质量的补充性衡量指标。

sents.en: Multimodal work also studies truthfulness and deception ( Kang et al., 2025b ; Kang et al., 2025a ) , personality judgments ( Kang et al., 2026 ) , and speaker alignment ( Ouyang et al., 2026a ) , alongside interactive digital humans ( Cai et al., 2025 ) and controllable multi-person video generation ( Ouyang et al., 2026b ) .
sents.zh: 多模态研究还探讨了真实性与欺骗性（Kang 等，2025b；Kang 等，2025a）、人格判断（Kang 等，2026）以及说话者一致性（Ouyang 等，2026a），此外还包括交互式数字人（Cai 等，2025）和可控的多人物视频生成（Ouyang 等，2026b）。

sents.en: HICO-Bench focuses on the plan reached through dialogue: whether it fits both participants’ private conditions and is supported by what they said.
sents.zh: HICO-Bench 关注通过对话达成的计划：该计划是否符合双方参与者的个人条件，并得到他们所说内容的支持。

sents.en: We retain SOTOPIA’s ratings as complementary measures of conversation quality.
sents.zh: 我们将保留 SOTOPIA 的评分，作为对对话质量的补充性衡量指标。

paragraphs.en: Several interactive benchmarks verify outcomes with rules. In Deal or No Deal and CaSiNo, agents divide items and the final split is scored against each agent’s private values ( Lewis et al., 2017 ; Chawla et al., 2021 ) ; τ \tau -bench and τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench check whether a customer-service agent leaves a database in the correct state ( Yao et al., 2024 ; Barres et al., 2025 ) ; Social Gym uses games whose winner is decided by rules ( He et al., 2026 ) . These settings target fixed, domain-specific goals. HICO-Bench extends outcome verification to everyday coordination and additionally checks that the conversation supports the plan.
paragraphs.zh: 多个交互式基准测试通过规则验证结果。 在《交易还是拒绝》和 CaSiNo 中，智能体对物品进行分配，最终分配结果会与每个智能体的个人价值进行比较评分（Lewis et al., 2017 ; Chawla et al., 2021）；τ \tau -bench 和 τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench 用于检验客服智能体是否将数据库留在了正确的状态（Yao et al., 2024 ; Barres et al., 2025）；Social Gym 使用由规则决定胜负的游戏（He et al., 2026）。 这些设置针对固定的、领域特定的目标。 HICO-Bench 将结果验证扩展到了日常协作场景，并进一步检验对话是否支持既定计划。

paragraphs.en: Prior work trains or evaluates models on asking clarifying questions, for example by rewarding questions that reveal user preferences ( Andukuri et al., 2024 ) or by scoring questions at checkpoints ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Related work on proactive assistance studies when to offer help from ongoing visual observations ( Gong et al., 2026b ; Gong et al., 2026a ) . We do not reward questions directly: in HICO-Bench, the decisive fact may be volunteered, already known, or elicited, and only the correctness of the resulting plan is rewarded.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究通过在提出澄清性问题上训练或评估模型，例如通过奖励能够揭示用户偏好的问题（Andukuri 等人，2024），或在检查点阶段对问题进行评分（Zhao 等人，2026；Zhang 等人，2024）。 关于主动协助的相关研究探讨了在持续进行视觉观察时何时提供帮助的问题（Gong 等人，2026b；Gong 等人，2026a）。 我们并不直接奖励问题：在 HICO-Bench 中，决定性事实可能是主动提供的、已经知道的，或是通过提问获得的，并且只有最终计划的正确性才会获得奖励。

paragraphs.en: When feedback arrives only at the end of an episode, a learner must estimate which earlier steps deserve credit. Process supervision labels each reasoning step ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) ; VinePPO estimates a step’s value by sampling continuations from it ( Kazemnejad et al., 2025 ) ; GiGPO and GraphGPO compare steps that share the same state across rollouts ( Feng et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) . For social agents, SOTOPIA-RL and SAVOIR distribute LLM-judge ratings over the utterances of a conversation ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) . In free-form dialogue, however, identical states rarely recur across rollouts, and LLM ratings are noisy. PaCPO instead compares tentative plans across the two worlds of a scenario and checks them with rules, so that each comparison is verifiable.
paragraphs.zh: 当反馈仅在回合结束时才出现时，学习者必须评估哪些早期步骤值得获得奖励。 Process Supervision 为每个推理步骤标注标签（Lightman 等，2024）；VinePPO 通过从该步骤采样后续内容来估计其价值（Kazemnejad 等，2025）；GiGPO 和 GraphGPO 则比较不同展开过程中共享相同状态的步骤（Feng 等，2025；Cheng 等，2026）。 对于社会智能体，SOTOPIA-RL 和 SAVOIR 将 LLM 判定的评分分配给对话中的各个发言（Yu 等，2025；Feng 等，2026）。 然而，在自由形式的对话中，相同的状态很少会在不同展开过程中重复出现，且 LLM 的评分存在噪声。 相比之下，PaCPO 会比较一个场景中两个世界里的临时计划，并通过规则对其进行验证，从而确保每次比较都可被核实。

paragraphs.en: Each scenario involves two roles, such as Maya and Leo in Figure 1 . Both roles see the same public context p p : the client pitch is tomorrow at 10 a.m., Maya is due to present, and Leo may present only if Maya cannot attend. Each role i i also receives a private role card v i v_{i} that the other role does not see; Maya’s card states whether she can attend and what help she wants. The roles then alternate free-form turns, producing a history h h . Each role observes only p p , its own card, and h h ; it never sees the partner’s card or the set of acceptable plans.
paragraphs.zh: 每个场景都涉及两个角色，例如图 1 中的 Maya 和 Leo。 两个角色都能看到相同的公共上下文 p p：客户提案会议将于明天上午 10 点举行，Maya 需要负责演示，而 Leo 只有在 Maya 无法出席的情况下才能进行演示。 每个角色 i i 还会收到一张只有自己能看到、对方看不到的私人角色卡 v i v_{i}；Maya 的卡片上写明了她能否出席以及她需要哪些帮助。 随后，两个角色轮流进行自由形式的回合，从而生成一个历史 h h。 每个角色只能观察到 p p、自己的卡片以及 h h；它永远看不到搭档的卡片或可接受方案集。

paragraphs.en: When the conversation ends, each role independently fills in a structured record c i c_{i} describing the plan it believes was agreed, following a public template 𝒞 \mathcal{C} (e.g., who presents and what Leo will do). A scenario is thus x = ( p , v 1 , v 2 , z , 𝒞 ) x=(p,v_{1},v_{2},z,\mathcal{C}) .

paragraphs.en: Each scenario has two worlds, w 0 w_{0} and w 1 w_{1} , that share the public context and differ in exactly one private condition, chosen so that no plan is correct in both. Following contrast sets ( Ribeiro et al., 2020 ; Gardner et al., 2020 ) , an agent that makes the same offer in both worlds must fail one of them.

paragraphs.en: PaCPO trains the agent with a terminal reward but redistributes it across turns. After each turn, we ask which plan the agent would record if the conversation ended there, and compare these tentative plans across the two worlds of a scenario. Before Maya reveals whether she can attend, Leo’s tentative plan is the same in both worlds and can fit at most one; once she does, the plans formed in the two worlds should diverge so that each fits its own world. paragraphs.en: We train Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) against a frozen Qwen3-8B partner. Each RL run uses 384 training conversations: one preassigned role per training scenario, balanced across scenarios, with two samples per world. During training, Integrity is scored by a frozen local Qwen3.8-27B judge ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: Figure 5 a breaks down the aggregate gains into changes across individual scenarios. Improvements and regressions occur within the same family, including the difficult scheduling settings. Figure 5 b shows one such improvement. Finley and Harper disclose nonoverlapping windows for using a shared table. Base incorrectly calls them overlapping, and its partner accepts that error. PaCPO instead identifies the four-minute gap and obtains agreement. Both runs ultimately submit the same feasible records, but only PaCPO’s conversation supports them. paragraphs.en: Effective social interaction should be judged not only by the conversation but also by the plan it produces. HICO-Bench evaluates this with paired scenarios and two checks, Feasibility and Integrity, whose conjunction defines Verified Success. Across thirteen LLMs, high conversation ratings often accompany plans that fail these checks. PaCPO uses the paired worlds to turn end-of-conversation outcomes into turn-level credit, improving Verified Success over the base model and RL baselines. These results suggest that verified outcomes complement conversation ratings, both for evaluation and as a training signal. The benchmark currently covers six coordination families with structured outcomes, and Integrity relies on an LLM judge; extending verification to less structured interactions and expanding human validation are important next steps (Appendices L and K ).
paragraphs.zh: 有效的社交互动不应仅凭对话本身来评判，还应看其产生的计划。 HICO-Bench 通过成对场景和两项检查——可行性与完整性——来评估这一点，这两项检查的联合结果定义了“验证成功”。 在十三种大型语言模型中，高对话评分往往伴随着未能通过这些检查的计划。 PaCPO 利用这些成对世界，将对话结束时的结果转化为回合级的信用值，从而在基础模型和强化学习基线方法上提升了“验证成功”率。 这些结果表明，验证结果能够补充对话评分，既可用于评估，也可作为训练信号。 该基准目前涵盖六个具有结构化结果的协作类别，且“完整性”检查依赖大型语言模型裁判；将验证扩展到结构较弱的互动，并增加人类验证，是重要的后续步骤（附录 L 和 K）。

paragraphs.en: An anchor key hashes the exact actor-input token sequence together with a flag distinguishing dialogue turns from final records. We disable approximate string matching and semantic state merging; partner-private fields and verifier state are not added to the key. paragraphs.en: GraphGPO builds a directed graph separately for each rollout group. Nodes are the same exact-history anchors, and unit-weight edges connect successive actor steps. Unreachable nodes receive the upstream fallback distance, one greater than the largest finite distance. This path score determines credit; it does not replace the terminal reward.

paragraphs.en: The training scenario branding_dilemma illustrates authorization. Avery, a new business owner uncertain about a brand change, requests an extra concept-review block from consultant Blair. The public context states that complimentary hours require delegated authority and that a pending referral is not approval. It does not disclose Avery’s requested duration or Blair’s authority limit.
paragraphs.zh: 训练场景 branding_dilemma 展示了授权机制。 新晋企业主艾弗里对品牌变更犹豫不决，因此向顾问布莱尔申请了额外的概念审查环节。 公开说明指出，免费服务时间需要经过授权委托，而待处理的转介并不等同于批准。 该说明并未披露艾弗里所请求的时长或布莱尔的授权上限。

paragraphs.zh: 我们在两种场景下评估了任务特定的训练方法：基于数据库的推荐和双边谈判。 表 4 报告了这些方法的结果。

paragraphs.en: We select hotel and restaurant goals from MultiWOZ 2.2 dialogue-state annotations ( Zang et al., 2020 ) and use the corresponding MultiWOZ 2.1 entity databases ( Eric et al., 2020 ) . Each source contributes one domain-specific recommendation task with explicit user constraints, such as area, price range, cuisine, or hotel amenities. We select goals with a database match and omit booking requests and requests for a preselected named entity. Train, development, and test retain their original source splits; repeated constraint profiles are removed across splits.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 MultiWOZ 2.2 对话状态标注（Zang et al., 2020）中选取酒店和餐厅目标，并使用相应的 MultiWOZ 2.1 实体数据库（Eric et al., 2020）。 每个数据源都贡献一个具有明确用户约束（如区域、价格范围、菜系或酒店设施）的领域特定推荐任务。 我们选择与数据库有匹配的目标，同时排除预订请求以及对预选命名实体的请求。 训练集、开发集和测试集保留其原始数据源划分；重复的约束配置文件在各个划分中被移除。

paragraphs.en: Each pair retains the public request and database while changing one private user constraint. Both worlds have valid recommendations, and their valid entity sets are disjoint. The visitor holds the requirements privately; the assistant asks questions, searches the database, and recommends one entity by name. A successful episode requires that the selected entity satisfy every private constraint and be unambiguously identified in the final message. This constraint communication endpoint tests whether elicited requirements reach the actual recommendation. The test set contains 77 paired scenarios and 154 dialogues.
paragraphs.zh: 每一对都保留公共请求和数据库，同时更改一个私有用户约束。 两个世界都有有效的推荐，且它们的有效实体集互不相交。 访客将需求保密；助手会提问、搜索数据库，并以名称推荐一个实体。 成功的一轮交互需要所选实体满足所有私有约束，并在最终消息中被明确无误地识别出来。 这个约束通信终点用于测试，已获取的需求是否最终能导向实际的推荐。 测试集包含 77 对场景和 154 段对话。

paragraphs.en: We retain CaSiNo’s campsite setting ( Chawla et al., 2021 ) , with three units each of food, water, and firewood. Each participant has private high-, medium-, and low-priority items, valued at 5, 4, and 3 points per unit, together with reasons for those preferences. To construct paired worlds, we keep the tested participant’s card fixed and replace the partner’s complete preference-and-reason card with one from the same original split. This changes which allocations benefit the partner while retaining the public negotiation setting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留了 CaSiNo 的营地设置（Chawla 等人，2021），其中食物、水和柴火各有三个单位。 每位参与者都有私人的高、中、低优先级物品，每单位分别值 5、4 和 3 分，并附有这些偏好的理由。 为了构建成对的世界，我们保持受测参与者的卡片不变，并将搭档的完整偏好与理由卡片替换为来自同一原始分组的卡片。 这样既改变了哪些分配能惠及搭档，又保留了公开协商的设置。

paragraphs.en: The participants negotiate a complete allocation that both accept. We report agreement rate and normalized Nash surplus, based on the Nash bargaining product ( Nash, 1950 ) . We take the product of both participants’ nonnegative utility gains above the five-point walk-away value and divide it by the maximum attainable product in that world. Episodes without agreement receive zero surplus. These measures distinguish reaching an agreement from finding a mutually beneficial allocation. The test set contains 43 paired scenarios and 86 dialogues.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者协商出一个双方都接受的完整分配方案。 我们报告了协议达成率与归一化纳什剩余，其计算基于纳什讨价还数乘积（Nash, 1950）。 我们将两位参与者超出五点退出值的部分的非负效用收益相乘，再除以该情境下可达到的最大乘积。 未达成协议的回合将获得零剩余。 这些指标能够区分达成协议与找到互利分配方案这两种情况。 测试集包含 43 个成对的情境和 86 段对话。

paragraphs.en: PaCPO’s largest Verified Success gain over Base occurs for bounded quantities, rising from 30.0% to 52.5%. It also improves authorization from 37.5% to 47.5%. For bounded quantities, PPO and PaCPO have identical Feasibility (75.0%), but PaCPO has higher Verified Success (52.5% versus 42.5%). The additional gain therefore lies in jointly satisfying feasibility and dialogue integrity, rather than increasing feasibility alone.
paragraphs.zh: PaCPO 相对于 Base 在有限数量场景下获得的“验证成功”最大提升，从 30.0% 上升至 52.5%。 它还将授权率从 37.5% 提升至 47.5%。 在有限数量场景下，PPO 和 PaCPO 的“可行性”相同（均为 75.0%），但 PaCPO 的“验证成功”更高（52.5% 对比 42.5%）。 因此，额外的提升源于同时满足可行性和对话完整性，而非仅提高可行性。

paragraphs.en: A task position identifies a scenario, world, and tested role. Selecting the first ten keys per family without replacement yields 60 shared positions spanning 43 scenarios. Selection uses task identifiers and family labels, not Feasibility or Integrity scores, and is fixed before Kimi-K3 is queried. We reuse each method’s output at these same positions without regenerating dialogues, giving 60 evaluations per method and 240 in total. Identical requests are scored once and reused, producing 203 unique Kimi-K3 requests; reported statistics give equal weight to all 240 model–task evaluations.

paragraphs.en: Two expert annotators review 48 dialogues from Base and PaCPO, covering 12 scenarios and both of their worlds, which form 24 matched Base–PaCPO pairs. For each dialogue, annotators see the public context, both role cards, the full conversation, and both records, with model identities hidden. They judge whether the final plan satisfies the stated conditions (Feasibility) and whether the participants’ utterances support it (Integrity). For each matched pair, presented in random order ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , they also judge which model provides more adequate help to the partner, citing turn-level evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 两名专家标注员审查了 Base 和 PaCPO 中的 48 段对话，涵盖 12 种场景以及双方的世界，这些对话构成了 24 组匹配的 Base–PaCPO 配对。 对于每段对话，标注员可以看到公开背景信息、双方的角色卡、完整的对话内容以及双方的记录，但模型身份被隐藏。 他们需要判断最终计划是否满足既定条件（可行性），以及参与者的发言是否支持该计划（完整性）。 对于每一组按随机顺序呈现的匹配配对（Zheng et al., 2023），他们还需要判断哪个模型为搭档提供了更充分的帮助，并引用具体轮次的证据作为依据。

paragraphs.en: Human Feasibility judgments agree with the executable checks on 100% of dialogues, and human Integrity judgments agree with Qwen3.8-Max on 82.22%. In the helpfulness comparison, annotators prefer PaCPO in 8 pairs and Base in 5, rate the two as similar in 3, and judge both inadequate in 8. PaCPO thus receives more favorable judgments, while one third of the pairs reveal cases in which neither model helps adequately.

paragraphs.en: HICO-Bench covers six coordination families whose arrangements can be represented as structured records and checked against explicit conditions. This supports reproducible feasibility tests, but does not cover the full range of social interaction, such as emotional support or relationships without a well-defined final outcome. Extending the benchmark requires identifying verifiable outcomes without reducing these interactions to inappropriate formal objectives. Feasibility success is feasibility under the specified conditions, not a general judgment of social appropriateness.
paragraphs.zh: HICO-Bench 涵盖了六个协调类别，其安排可以表示为结构化记录，并与明确的条件进行核对。 这支持了可重复的可行性测试，但并未涵盖社会互动的全部范围，例如情感支持或没有明确最终结果的关系。 扩展该基准需要识别可验证的结果，同时不能将这些互动简化为不恰当的形式化目标。 可行性成功是指在指定条件下的可行性，而非对社会适宜性的普遍判断。
